title: Health Resort management warehouse safe key

infobox.usage: Used to open a locked Safe in the Administration Building on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort management warehouse safe key (Safe) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium warehouse safe, located in the Administration building.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: - On the 2nd floor of the north wing of the health resort on Shoreline
